external_acoustic_meatus_bony_estimate.method: Rays cast medially over the auricle's y-z footprint onto the temporal bone; the meatus is the largest enclosed depression (>=6 mm from bone edges) relative to the 20 mm median surface level. opening_centre = (lateral surface level, centroid y, z); deepest_point = deepest first hit inside the canal. Approximate (99%-reduced mesh).
